📖 How to use

  1. Paste your page HTML (or just the <img> tags) into the box.
  2. Every image is listed with its alt text and length.
  3. Fix the flagged issues: missing, empty, over 125 chars, or redundant "image of…".

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does it read the alt text?

It parses <img> tags from your HTML with a real attribute parser and extracts the alt and src of each one — all in your browser.

How long should alt text be?

Under ~125 characters. Screen readers may cut off longer text, and concise descriptions rank better for image SEO.

What counts as bad alt text?

Missing or empty alt, alt longer than 125 chars, alt that is just the filename (IMG_2041.jpg), and redundant starts like "image of" or "picture of".
